topic: BTSP的分子秒表：CaMKII的延迟随机激活（DDSC）机制

sources.title: Conjunctive input processing drives feature selectivity in hippocampal CA1 neurons
sources.authors: Bittner KC, Grienberger C, Vaidya SP, Milstein AD, Macklin JJ, Suh J, Tonegawa S, Magee JC
sources.used_for: BTSP发现论文：单次树突平台电位在一次穿越中建立场所场
sources.key_finding: Single dendritic plateau potentials are sufficient to drive novel place field formation in one trial

sources.title: Behavioral time scale synaptic plasticity underlies CA1 place fields
sources.authors: Bittner KC, Milstein AD, Grienberger C, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Magee JC
sources.used_for: BTSP时间窗口量化（±3–4秒），非对称向后偏置窗口，BTSP命名论文
sources.key_finding: BTSP has an asymmetric temporal window of ~3-4s before and ~2-3s after the plateau potential; average 1.4 plateau events to form a place field

sources.title: A critical role for CaMKII in behavioral timescale synaptic plasticity in hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons
sources.authors: Xiao K, Li Y, Chitwood RA, Magee JC
sources.used_for: αCaMKII T286A突变阻断BTSP，证明CaMKII自磷酸化的激活维持时间（8.2s→1.9s）是BTSP的关键
sources.key_finding: αCaMKII T286A homozygous mice show near-complete loss of BTSP; decay constant 8.2s (WT) vs 1.9s (mutant)

sources.title: Dendritic, delayed, stochastic CaMKII activation in behavioural time scale plasticity
sources.authors: Jain A, Nakahata Y, Pancani T, Watabe T, Rusina P, South K, Adachi K, Yan L, Simorowski N, Furukawa H, Yasuda R
sources.used_for: 核心新发现：DDSC机制，IP₃依赖ER延迟钙释放驱动CaMKII在10-100s后激活，paAIP2光遗传因果实验
sources.key_finding: CaMKII activates 10-100s after plateau potential (DDSC), driven by IP3-dependent ER Ca release; blocking DDSC at 15-30s prevents BTSP; DDSC is causally required for BTSP

sources.title: Rapid formation of non-spatial hippocampal representations consistent with behavioral timescale synaptic plasticity is modulated by entorhinal input
sources.authors: Dorian CC, Taxidis J, Arac A, Golshani P
sources.used_for: BTSP扩展到非空间领域：嗅觉工作记忆任务中的气味特异性CA1响应，MEC/LEC解离
sources.key_finding: BTSP-like events in olfactory WM task: single plateau-like Ca events generate stable odor-specific CA1 representations; MEC gates event frequency, LEC provides odor-specific content

sources.title: Behavioral Timescale Synaptic Plasticity: A Burst in the Field of Learning and Memory
sources.authors: Madar AD, Milstein AD, O'Dell TJ, Jain A, Clopath C, Sheffield MEJ
sources.used_for: BTSP综述：现状、信用分配框架、未解问题（人类保守性、STDP相互作用）
sources.key_finding: BTSP addresses temporal credit assignment via dendritic plateau potentials; key open questions: human conservation, interaction with STDP, in vivo trigger frequency

sources.title: Bidirectional synaptic plasticity rapidly modifies hippocampal representations
sources.authors: Milstein AD, Li Y, Bittner KC, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Magee JC
sources.used_for: 双向BTSP：平台电位可双向修改场所场（增强或缩小）
sources.key_finding: BTSP is bidirectional: plateau potentials can strengthen or shrink existing place fields depending on position
